answer.rationale: p99 write latency is 5x target in primary region during peak settlement load. Rollback is blocked by compliance-required security patch. Regional failover has proven fast recovery (memory_b2: restored latency within minutes during March degradation). This approach: (1) avoids rollback which violates compliance, (2) preserves all customer writes by shifting to healthy region during peak settlement, (3) leverages headroom strategy (memory_b3) by redirecting load away from saturated primary, (4) aligns with circuit breaker fast-fail logic (memory_b4) by removing degraded path. Verification targets memory_b2 to confirm failover mechanics and timing under similar conditions. Add capacity is too slow for immediate relief; read replica routing (memory_b5) addresses reporting load, not transactional write path saturation. Standard experiment scope appropriate: this is a targeted regional shift, not a full rollout, with immediate revert if metrics worsen.
